definitions.explanation: The body or structural frame of an aircraft or spacecraft. Also used to refer to the aircraft itself as a unit.

examples.japanese: {機体|きたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{損傷|そんしょう}→損傷：21079_sonshou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There was no damage to the aircraft.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{機体|きたい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{軽量|けいりょう}→軽量：19124_keiryou⟧な⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This airframe is made of lightweight materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{機体|きたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧、⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: The aircraft shook violently in the strong wind, making the passengers uneasy.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in aviation contexts, news reports about flights, and technical writing. Can refer to the physical body/frame of the aircraft or the aircraft as a whole.

NOTE: This is a homophone of ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧ (expectation) and ⟦{気体|きたい}→気体：02632_kitai⟧ (gas), so context is essential for distinguishing them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {機体|きたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧ (aircraft inspection)
- {機体|きたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れる→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧ (the aircraft shakes)
- {機体|きたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{整備|せいび}→整備：04037_seibi⟧ (aircraft maintenance)
